svg.title: API create GitHub IdP returns a one-time enterprise-setup URL that can 500
svg.desc: POST identity_providers type github succeeds and may include a messages entry pointing at /cdn-cgi/access/enterprise-setup/ with an opaque token. That URL can return Cloudflare error 500 Internal server error. Use Zero Trust Finish setup instead. Token redacted.
svg.text: SIMPLIFIED MOCK - redacted API message. Do not paste the opaque token into docs.
messages[0]: Finish enterprise enablement by going to
One-shot. GET on the IdP later does not return this URL again.
Cloudflare error 500 - Internal server error - a Ray ID
Not a bad Client ID. The setup token endpoint is fragile.
Fallback: dashboard Finish setup, then Test. Or first GitHub login on the app.
